summary: Parked-up kerb backing onto a cleared vacant lot, steep at about 9%.
reasons: Vacant cleared land on the kerb side
Homes only across the road, 14 m+

best_section.where: North kerb beside the cleared lot, before the arterial junction

drivers.seclusion: Kerb backs onto a cleared vacant lot and a flats block; the nearest homes are across the road, 14-15 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide street with a parked-car lane along this kerb; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Side street ending at a busy arterial just below; modest traffic on the street itself.
drivers.convention: Several cars park here, so a van would blend in.

flags: Steep: about 9% at best section, 11% mean along the stretch
Arterial road noise at the lower end
House 14 m away at the start (0 m), so avoid the first few metres
sun_shade: Open to the sun; trees shade the lower end from the west in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Future development of the cleared lot
